scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: An average hides a gap
scenes.caption: Asha reviews two supplied input groups for the same low-stakes library task. Each has ten examples with five staff-review cases. One group contains full-text enquiries; the other contains abbreviated or alternative-format text.
scenes.dialogue: Compare denominators as well as percentages.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Who is missed
scenes.caption: The prepared results find four of five staff-review cases in group A and two of five in group B. That is eighty percent versus forty percent recall in these tiny groups. The gap does not by itself establish a cause or a universal claim about people.
scenes.dialogue: A group result is evidence to investigate.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Write the model card
scenes.caption: Record intended use, synthetic-data provenance, evaluation counts, group and shift limitations and a human override. Keep an accessible manual route. Check permission to use source material and provide attribution; a citation alone does not establish permission.
scenes.dialogue: The assurance pack includes limits and responsibilities.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the next action
scenes.caption: Should Asha hide the smaller group, assume its users are inherently unsuitable, or document the gap, involve users in an accessible review and collect fresh independent evidence after improvements?
scenes.dialogue: A gap calls for investigation and a usable alternative.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A practical mitigation
scenes.caption: The team records the weak group result, keeps staff review available and plans a revised accessible workflow with a fresh evaluation. Requests outside scope or involving private data have explicit override and stop-use routes.
scenes.dialogue: A model card is useful only when its limits change action.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the assurance lab
scenes.caption: Calculate the group recalls, complete the model card and select safeguards for accessibility, data use and human authority. Your teacher reviews the reasoning; the tiny pack is not a general fairness certificate.
scenes.dialogue: State what you measured and what remains unknown.
